scripts.build: npm run build:icons && tsc -b apps/cli && npm run build -w @sysarch/web && npm run build -w @sysarch/reactflow-test && npm run build -w @sysarch/obsidian
scripts.web: npm run build:icons && npm run dev -w @sysarch/web
scripts.reactflow-test: npm run build:icons && npm run dev -w @sysarch/reactflow-test
scripts.obsidian: npm run build:icons && npm run dev -w @sysarch/obsidian
scripts.obsidian:install: npm run build:icons && npm run build -w @sysarch/obsidian && tsx scripts/install-obsidian.ts
scripts.docs: npm run build:icons && npm run dev -w @sysarch/docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:icons && npm run build -w @sysarch/docs && npm run build -w @sysarch/web && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'apps/docs/.vitepress/dist/app', { recursive: true })"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:icons && tsc -b packages/render-svg packages/export-reactflow packages/export-png && tsc -p packages/core/test && tsc -p packages/themes/test && tsc -p packages/layout/test && tsc -p packages/render-svg/test && tsc -p packages/export-reactflow/test && tsc -p packages/export-png/test && tsc -b apps/cli && tsc -p apps/cli/test && tsc -b packages/editor && tsc -p packages/editor/test && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/reactflow-test && tsc -p apps/obsidian && tsc -p apps/obsidian/test && tsc -p apps/docs
